On this episode of presents , Gurleen Pannu talks about her cool aunt who helped her sneak into open mics, Taapsee Pannu teaches us a few words in Danish & Abish introduces everyone to the Malayalam way of calling him “Chetta.”
Special thanks to Gini for coming on and performing her track ‘Khauf’
